protocol.question: Does current main sustain about 4500 complete structures/min and low additional unified-RAM pressure on diverse native repertoires as job size increases?
protocol.unchanged_settings: Installed defaults: strict FP32, saved AOT, native writer, auto batch16/32, CPU workers2, seed42, chemistry off. No embeddings/output cache. Base/plddt only; language 4500/min claim does not apply.
protocol.selection_scope: Throughput and memory engineering panels, not model-accuracy benchmarks. OAS selection is diversity balanced by study, not a natural repertoire-frequency sample. Native pairing preserved; no synthetic combinations or sequence repeats within any panel.

protocol.timing: Host wall time around unwrapped installed docker CLI, including startup/load/inference/all PDB writes/exit. Output checks and idle windows excluded. --batch-report serialization included.
protocol.memory: Same calibrated MemAvailable baseline-delta estimator: 5s pre idle, 20ms system sampling, 8s post idle. Flag >0.25GiB drift; retain all observations. No cache dropping. Does not double count CPU/GPU mappings.
protocol.long_run_progress: inotify CLOSE_WRITE events for PDBs, observed every20ms and recorded every1s. Counts cross-checked with exact filenames. No model hooks or timers in inference.
protocol.verification: All expected files and END records; 128 deterministic finite-coordinate/CA-count samples per case plus every naturally out-of-AOT-length input. Check batch report completion, OOM and fallback counts. Performance only, not an accuracy study.
protocol.limits: 16 finite cases, 459024 total outputs, ~65GiB expected outputs; check 100GiB free-disk reserve before each run. Main unchanged. No previous-version reruns.

selection.scope: Throughput and memory engineering panels, not model-accuracy benchmarks. OAS selection is diversity balanced by study, not a natural repertoire-frequency sample. Native pairing preserved; no synthetic combinations or sequence repeats within any panel.
selection.global_deduplication: Exact pair identity; lexicographically first study/unit/row occurrence kept. Original source evidence retained locally.
selection.ordering: Smallest seeded SHA256 per study; equal study quotas capped at availability; pick-rank interleaving. Nested 1k/10k/100k CSVs.
selection.filters: Committed native pairs, both complete, not benchmark-excluded, canonical 20AA, IGK/IGL. Historical source quality is not a new annotation audit.
selection.selection_metadata_scope: Sequence IDs and original row/unit metadata local only; report aggregate counts and input hashes.
